channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Iran says strait remains closed until U.S. changes behavior
item.description: The UAE's Abu Dhabi National Oil Company reported that one of its ships was attacked while passing through the strait on Saturday.

item.title: Video shows Alabama deputies capturing a 1,500-pound runaway bull
item.description: The Pickens County Sheriff's Office reported that after some difficulty, the bull was safely returned without injury.

item.title: How social media apps can support children's mental health
item.description: ABC News' Stephanie Ramos discussed with Dr. Megan Moreno the nearly billion-dollar penalty against Meta and its implications.

item.title: Why Trump's ballroom is a national security concern
item.description: Despite a court blocking his $400 million ballroom project, President Trump insists it must proceed for unspecified reasons.
